correctness.rationale: Synchronous coupling ensures unique stationary law. Conditioning on the full past Poisson history produces X|V Gaussian with 0<V<sigma², with endpoint gap Delta=sigma²−V=UW; U=e^(−2 kappa T) has Beta(beta,1) distribution and W=sigma²−a² Vprime lies in [sigma²(1−a²),sigma²]. Generator recursion yields exact even-moment product. The independent endpoint integral gives n^beta E[(V/sigma²)^n]→Gamma(1+beta) E[(sigma²/W)^beta], identifying the infinite-product amplitude P(a,beta). Laplace rescaling of U near zero proves sharp density p(x)~C |x|^(−2beta) exp(−x²/(2sigma²)); critical conditional Gaussian exponential moment is E[U^(−1/2)]E[(sigma²/W)^(1/2)], finite precisely beta>1/2, equivalently r>kappa. Independently checked recurrence at kappa=D=r=1,a=.5: moments m2=0.7272727272727, m4=1.7675489067894. For theta>1/(2sigma²) a positive reset-free interval generates divergent conditional mgf. All asymptotics are fixed-parameter; no uniform a→1 assertion.
residual_risks: The density equivalent is not uniform as a approaches 1 or the reset rate vanishes.
